shortDescription: Dashboard home view with a three-column GitHub-style dark layout.
fullDescription: Implements the dashboard-home view in its default state as a full-width desktop layout with a top navigation bar, repository sidebar, central home feed, AI prompt composer, action pills, repository recommendation cards, and a right rail with a promotional event card and changelog timeline. The view exposes a state prop for supported screen states and keeps visible inputs, selects, menus, and buttons interactive with local presentational state.
